candidates.name: Alex Mercer
answers: I am a senior developer with 8 years of experience. I specialize in backend systems, Python, and scalable cloud architectures. In my previous role, I led a team of five engineers to rebuild our core API.

When I disagree with a team member, I schedule a 1-on-1 to discuss the technical merits of both approaches. We try to rely on data and prototyping rather than opinions. Ultimately, we align on what is best for the product.

I was asked to implement a new Kubernetes cluster but had no prior DevOps experience. I spent my evenings taking a certified course, set up a sandbox environment, and successfully migrated our staging environment within three weeks.
